lp.s.purpose.map.text: The writer's purpose: Nobody knows who took the map. Report only what happened to it.

lp.s.purpose.decision.text: The writer's purpose: Make it clear who made the decision: the coach.

lp.s.purpose.samples.text: The writer's purpose: A science report: focus on what was done, not on who did it.

lp.s.purpose.mural.text: The writer's purpose: Give credit to the student who painted the mural.

lp.s.purpose.gate.text: The writer's purpose: A safety notice: the important thing is the gate, not who locks it.

lp.s.purpose.vase.text: The writer's purpose: Report what happened to the vase without blaming anyone.

lp.s.purpose.award.text: The writer's purpose: Make it clear who won the award: Priya's team.

lp.s.purpose.bridge.text: The writer's purpose: The news is the bridge, not the builders.

lp.s.purpose.fair.text: The writer's purpose: Show that the students organized the fair themselves.

lp.s.purpose.bread.text: The writer's purpose: A menu note: what matters is the bread, not the baker.

lp.s.shift.fence.text: Tomás painted the fence, and then the gate was painted by him.

lp.s.shift.poem.text: Nia wrote the poem, and it was read aloud by her at the assembly.

lp.s.shift.seeds.text: The class planted the seeds, and then the beds were watered by them.

lp.s.shift.tent.text: Kenji packed the tent, and the stove was carried to the car by him.

lp.s.shift.cans.text: The volunteers sorted the cans, and the bottles were washed by them.

lp.s.shift.jam.text: Mei baked the bread, and the jam was made by her too.

lp.s.shift.robot.text: Our team built the robot, and the code was written by us as well.

lp.s.shift.kitten.text: Zara found the lost kitten, and it was carried home by her.

lp.s.shift.sign.text: The ranger checked the trail, and the broken sign was fixed by him.

lp.s.shift.pools.text: Omar measured the tide pools, and the crabs were counted by him.

lp.s.shift.poster.text: Priya designed the poster, and the copies were printed by her at the library.

lp.s.shift.song.text: The choir learned the song, and it was performed by them at the harbor festival.

lp.s.shift.letters.text: The letters were sorted by the post office, and then the post office delivered them.

lp.a.sundays.text: Open the library on Sundays. The library should open on Sundays. Last term's sign-in sheets show about 40 visitors every Saturday. The library also has bright blue doors. A survey at the desk found that 25 of those visitors work on weekdays. So a Sunday opening would serve people who can't come in during the week.

lp.a.barrel.text: The school garden needs a second rain barrel. The school garden needs a second rain barrel. The garden log shows the one barrel ran dry on 9 of the last 12 dry days. On those days, volunteers carried water from the kitchen in buckets. This means one barrel can't store enough rain for the whole garden. Rain barrels come in green, black and gray.

lp.a.ferry.text: Add an earlier ferry. The ferry should add a trip at 6:30 a.m. Everyone knows the ferry is the best way to see the island. Ticket records show the 7:30 trip was full on 18 of 20 weekdays last month. The ferry office counted 35 riders turned away from that trip in one week. So an earlier trip would carry riders who now can't get on.

lp.a.savory.text: A savory category for the bake-off. The island bake-off should add a savory category. Last year, 12 of the 40 entries were breads or pies with no sugar. The judges' notes show they had trouble comparing those entries with cakes. The bake-off tent was first put up in the town square. This means a separate savory category would make the judging fairer.

lp.a.bins.text: More recycling bins for Harbor Park. Harbor Park needs more recycling bins. Cleanup volunteers collected 60 cans from the grass in one weekend. The park has two recycling bins, both near the main gate. So people far from the gate have nowhere close to put their cans. The park's fountain was repaired last spring.

lp.a.lights.text: Keep the skate ramp lights on. The skate ramp lights should stay on until 8 p.m. Skating is obviously the coolest sport on the island. A youth club count found 15 skaters still on the ramp at 6:30 most evenings. The lights switch off at 6:30, and the ramp has no other lighting. This means skaters are riding in the dark, which is unsafe.

lp.a.soup.text: Bring back soup at lunch. The school should bring back a soup option at lunch. In a survey, 120 of 200 students chose soup as their favorite winter lunch. The cafeteria was painted yellow two years ago. Kitchen records show soup cost less per serving than sandwiches. So soup would be both popular and affordable.

lp.a.boardwalk.text: A boardwalk for the tide pools. The island should build a boardwalk to the tide pools. Rangers report that most visitors step right onto the rocks to reach the pools. Last year's survey counted far fewer sea stars beside the path than in the far pools. This means a boardwalk could protect the animals by keeping feet off the rocks. Sea stars can be orange, purple or brown.

lp.a.rack.text: A bike rack for the community hall. The community hall needs a bike rack. During one week of events, staff counted 22 bikes leaning against the walls. The hall can hold 150 people for a concert. Two of those bikes blocked the fire door. So a rack would keep the doors clear and the bikes tidy.

lp.a.musicroom.text: Open the music room at lunch. The music room should be open at lunchtime. A sign-up sheet collected 31 names of students who want to practice at lunch. The room schedule shows the room is empty from 12:00 to 12:45 every day. Music is far more fun than any other subject. This means students could practice without taking space from any class.

lp.a.crosswalk.text: Paint a crosswalk by the market. The town should paint a crosswalk outside the market. A traffic count found 300 people crossing the road there on one Saturday. The nearest crosswalk is 400 meters away. So most shoppers cross where there is no safe place to do it. The market sells fruit from six different farms.

lp.a.bookswap.text: A book swap shelf at the ferry dock. The ferry dock should have a book swap shelf. Ferry staff timed an average wait of 25 minutes before each trip. The dock was rebuilt with wood from the old pier. A rider survey found that 70 of 100 riders read while they wait. This means a shelf of books would be used by many waiting riders.

lp.a.evenings.text: Open the community garden in the evening. The community garden should open on weekday evenings. A members' survey found 45 of 60 members can't visit between 9 and 3. Plots left unweeded for a month rose from 5 to 18 this year. Gardening is the most relaxing hobby there is. So evening hours would let members look after their plots.

lp.a.shade.text: Plant shade trees at the playground. The playground needs shade trees. Rangers measured the slide at 140°F on three July afternoons. The playground has no shade between noon and 4 p.m. The playground's swings were painted red last year. This means children have nowhere cool to play on summer afternoons.

lp.a.lostfound.text: Move the lost-and-found box. The lost-and-found box should move to the front office. Right now the box is in the gym storeroom, which is locked after 3 p.m. Only 8 of the 50 items left last term were ever collected. So a place that stays open longer would help more items get back to their owners. Most of the lost items were blue water bottles.

lp.a.benchstop.text: A bench for the lighthouse bus stop. The lighthouse bus stop needs a bench. The lighthouse is clearly the prettiest building on the island. The timetable shows gaps of up to 40 minutes between buses at that stop. Drivers report that older riders often sit on the curb while they wait. This means a bench would give waiting riders a safe place to sit.

lp.s.strongest.pool.text: Claim: The town pool should open an hour earlier.

lp.s.strongest.art.text: Claim: The art club needs a bigger room.

lp.s.strongest.trash.text: Claim: The beach needs more trash cans.

lp.s.strongest.bikes.text: Claim: The noon ferry should allow bikes.

lp.s.strongest.graphic.text: Claim: The library should buy more graphic novels.

lp.s.strongest.chess.text: Claim: The school should start a chess club.

lp.s.strongest.grip.text: Claim: The skate ramp needs fresh grip paint.

lp.s.strongest.late.text: Claim: The market should stay open until 7 p.m.

lp.s.strongest.roof.text: Claim: The ferry dock needs a covered waiting area.

lp.s.strongest.thursday.text: Claim: The museum should open late on Thursdays.

lp.s.strongest.guard.text: Claim: The crossing outside the school needs a crossing guard.

lp.s.strongest.tomatoes.text: Claim: The school garden should grow more tomatoes next year.

lp.s.enough.timetable.text: Two people on the bus said the timetable is confusing. Is that enough to say most riders find it confusing?

lp.s.enough.butter.text: The bake-off judges tasted all 40 entries, and 31 of them used butter. Is that enough to say most entries used butter?

lp.s.enough.crab.text: Kofi saw one crab at the tide pools today. Is that enough to say the crab numbers are shrinking?

lp.s.enough.lunch.text: A survey of 250 of the school's 300 students found that 200 want a longer lunch. Is that enough to say most students want a longer lunch?

lp.s.enough.playground.text: Mina's three friends all prefer the new playground. Is that enough to say the whole town prefers it?

lp.s.enough.saturday.text: The library counted visitors every day for a year: Saturday was the busiest day in 50 of the 52 weeks. Is that enough to say Saturday is usually its busiest day?

lp.s.enough.monday.text: One rainy Monday, the ferry ran late. Is that enough to say the ferry is usually late?

lp.s.enough.muffins.text: A café owner says her muffins are the best on the island. Is that enough to say they are the best?

lp.s.enough.seastars.text: Rangers counted the sea stars in every tide pool each spring for five years, and the count fell every year. Is that enough to say the number of sea stars has gone down?

lp.s.enough.meeting.text: At the town meeting, the five people who spoke all wanted a new skate park. Is that enough to say most of the town wants one?

lp.s.enough.cars.text: A count of every car at the market crossing for two weeks found about 900 cars a day. Is that enough to say the crossing is busy?

lp.s.enough.mathbook.text: One student said the new math book is too hard. Is that enough to say the book is too hard for the whole class?
